what: a window 240 deg round the saddle-shaped inner wall of a torus (R20, r8) between z = -3 and 3, its cut faces taken off, patched g1 and stitched
method: the box x -6..13, y -13..13, z -3..3 opens the inner wall where 12 cos a >= -6 (|a| <= 120 deg): its rim is two arcs on z = +-3 each way and two curves on x = -6, and it bounds no height field. G1: the fill's tangent plane is the torus's all round the rim. The fill's shape is its own: one closed valid solid is the right answer.
